comment: The engine capability MCP surface shipped through @threenative/core. The golden path also calls a mechanically explicit cross-system request so a packaged consumer proves full-request discovery without repository source.

scope.description: Use request for the complete cross-system game request; use mechanic or omit it for one mechanic.

importPath.description: The search result's importPath; required when two packages export the same symbol.

game.description: Pinned game reference: version, id, title, repo, sha (40 hex), nodes [{id,name,purpose,parent?,paths,functions:[{name,path,lines:[from,to]}],dependsOn}], cards [{id,node,name,summary,behavior,constants:[{name,value,unit,source}],sources:[{path,line}],capabilities,tags}]. No extra fields or code fences.

descriptions.engine_search_capabilities: Search the installed engine by concrete gameplay mechanic. Decompose genres first. Use scope "request" for the mechanically explicit full request and "mechanic" for each focused search; matchedSituation and score explain every result. The response verdict "none" is an actionable answer with guidance, not a failed search.
descriptions.engine_capability_detail: Inspect one engine capability's import, signature, example, constraints, and overrides. When several packages export the symbol, every match is returned under `matches`.
descriptions.engine_search_references: Reverse engineer classic games: search mechanic cards and repository map nodes from their decomps. Tier-2 titles link to repos to explore and save. References describe feel only; borrow algorithms, cite pinned sources, copy no code or art.
descriptions.engine_reference_detail: Reverse engineer a game: read its pinned map or mechanic card. A node includes files, key functions, dependencies and child nodes; a card includes constants and sources.
descriptions.engine_save_reference: Save what you reverse engineer: validate and save a pinned game's repository map and mechanic cards to .threenative/refs, merged by id at the same SHA; conflicting revisions are refused. Pass a game object with version:1, id, title, repo, sha, nodes and cards. Returns a POSIX-shell contribution command for review; does not send it. Unknown fields and fenced code are refused.
